generated_text.overview: Project adafruit/kicad-libraries Minimal P4 current is a KiCad project containing 85 extracted component records. The catalogue matcher linked 38 physical placements to OOMP parts.
design_notes: The extracted board outline is approximately 25.3852 mm by 15.5286 mm.
Placement data contains 13 front-side and 32 back-side components.
review_notes: 7 physical component records are not yet matched to an OOMP part.
The extractor reports 106 named-net comparisons that differ between schematic and PCB data.
